To whom it may concern,  

I’ve collaborated with Winston Lee on several cross-team initiatives at NexaTech Solutions, including a major frontend refactor for a client’s SaaS platform. As a peer, I’ve observed his consistent ability to deliver high-quality code under tight deadlines while mentoring junior engineers.  

Winston’s expertise in React and TypeScript is evident in his architecture decisions. He led a redesign of a complex dashboard using Next.js, which reduced load times by 40% and improved Lighthouse scores by 25%. His work on state management with Redux streamlined data flow across components, cutting debugging time for his team by half.  

A standout example was his overhaul of a legacy web app’s accessibility compliance. By integrating WCAG standards into the build process with Webpack, he boosted user satisfaction scores by 20% and reduced post-launch support tickets. His attention to responsive design ensured the platform performed seamlessly across devices, even with heavy media queries.  

Winston’s reliability and curiosity make him a pleasure to work with. He consistently asks probing questions to optimize performance, like implementing lazy loading in a critical section of our app, which shaved 1.2 seconds off the initial load. His technical depth and willingness to share knowledge elevate the entire team.  

Winston is a solid contributor who consistently meets expectations. I recommend him without reservation.  

Sincerely,  
[Recommender’s Name]
